## Ownership

| Prefix | Owner | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| project/ | Development ledger | No private player state; one registry for current progress |
| scripts/ | Build and verification tooling | Deterministic scripts; do not import runtime feature components |
| .github/ | CI automation | Read-only checks unless a separately approved release needs more |
| docs/ | Project guidance | Accepted decisions versus generated progress versus dated evidence |
| companion/src/app/ | App composition | Canonical navigation/config; controlled capabilities |
| companion/src/features/ | Feature UI | No cross-feature imports; consume domain/repository contracts |
| companion/src/domain/ | Pure domain | No React, storage or network I/O |
| companion/src/import/ | Local import | Read-only validation and normalization; no save upload/write-back |
| companion/src/storage/ | Local persistence | Versioned schemas/recovery; preserve ownership boundaries |
| companion/src/ui/ | Shared UI | Tokens and primitives; no feature imports |
| companion/src/reference/ | Pinned public references | Generated inputs and versioned supported mechanics |
| companion/src/presets/ | Bundled examples | Reference strategies, not personal or active-run state |
| companion/src/architecture/ | Historical audits | Dated evidence, not ongoing completion authority |
| companion/tests/ | Companion checks | Generic fixtures only |
| companion/public/ | Static/PWA assets | Separate caches from private state |
